name: RapidRAW
title: RapidRAW: free Lightroom alternative
hook: Lightroom charges you twelve bucks a month to edit your raw photos. This app does it for free.

features.say: Sliders, curves and color tools fix your light, and your originals stay untouched.
Brush over a person or a speck of dust, and AI removes it, all on your own computer.
It opens raw files from Canon, Nikon and Sony, and exports JPEG or TIFF.

caption:
Lightroom charges $11.99/month to edit your raw photos. RapidRAW does it for free 📸

✅ Edit raw photos with sliders, curves and color tools
✅ Non-destructive: your original files stay untouched
✅ Brush over people or dust and AI removes them, running on your own computer
✅ Opens raw files from Canon, Nikon, Sony and more, exports JPEG or TIFF
✅ No subscription, no uploads, no paywall

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · Android
ℹ️ The editor and its AI tools run free on your own computer; there's an optional paid cloud add-on for heavier AI fills. A dedicated GPU and 16GB of RAM are recommended
